title: Step 32 Route-A scaling/topology audit
scope: Execution-level consistency checks and dimensional scaling; not a proof or refutation of Yau-26.

page_model_correction.correction: Page metric is on CP^2#CPbar^2 (one smooth blow-up, exceptional square -1), not a degenerating EH/A1 desingularization family.

page_model_correction.conclusion: The proposed Page annulus-flux test has no bubble scale t and no A1 exceptional (-2)-sphere; a null flux computation on Page would be only a consistency check for an exact rigid Einstein metric, not evidence against Route A.

obstruction_amplitude_scaling.model_estimate: Ric(g_t)-Lambda g_t-t*lambda*chi_t*o = O_{g_cal}(t^2 rho^2), g_t~t g_cal on the Calabi/EH core.
obstruction_amplitude_scaling.operator_norm_conversion: A (0,2)-tensor norm/endomorphism size scales by t^{-1}; hence t*lambda*o becomes lambda*(g_cal^{-1}o), while O(t^2 rho^2) becomes O(t rho^2).
obstruction_amplitude_scaling.non_scalar_distance: inf_a ||lambda*g_cal^{-1}o - a Id||_op = |lambda|*(spectral spread of g_cal^{-1}o)/2.
obstruction_amplitude_scaling.conclusion: Within a gluing normal form with nonzero first obstruction coefficient, Yau26's pointwise Ricci-endomorphism pinching cannot tend to zero. Weighted or L^p smallness misses this scale-critical core defect.

bilinear_flux_dimensional_scaling.Wronskian_boundary_signal: area*(H2*∂H4 - H4*∂H2) ~ r^3*(r^2*t^4*r^{-5}) ~ t^4 (and similarly for the other term), independent of r.
bilinear_flux_dimensional_scaling.delta_nonconservation_on_dyadic_balanced: If the residual is only ||Ric-g||_op<=delta, pairing with the natural linearized modes gives delta*∫|H2| or delta*∫|t^4H4| ~ delta*t^4. Thus exponent a=6 in delta*r^a, since r^6=t^4 at balance.
bilinear_flux_dimensional_scaling.caution: Across a long neck, pairing with t^4 r^{-4} over all dyadic shells can introduce logarithmic/summability issues; the rate-free statement is safest for a localized balanced-shell or genuinely conserved bilinear Wronskian identity.
bilinear_flux_dimensional_scaling.why_linear_Eg_is_wrong_object: The vector-field cosmological Einstein tensor flux has bulk scale delta*r^4 for Z~r, L_Z g~1. At r=t^(2/3) this is delta*t^(8/3), larger than t^4 unless delta<<t^(4/3), and in any case it is linear and blind to the H2-H4 Taub cross term.

important_limits: det R_+=0 alone is only an algebraic first-obstruction condition and does not imply Hermitian or Kähler geometry.

LeBrun--Ozuch Theorem B, per the dossier, assumes an exact positive Einstein sequence, Hermitian Einstein orbifold limit, a genuine singularity, and ASD Ricci-flat ALE bubbles. It cannot yet be applied to arbitrary C^0-pinched branch-(b) sequences.

Minimal resolutions of Du Val points are crepant; -K becomes nef rather than ample, so the natural KE metric on the singular Q-Fano does not automatically lift to a KE metric on the smooth resolution. Yau26 only needs some Einstein metric, and Page/CLW show non-KE Einstein metrics can fill low-degree gaps.
The Ozuch 2020 T^4/Z2 chessboard family is Lambda=0/K3-compatible evidence; it should not be carried as a positive Lambda counterexample locus without sign-specific checking.
classification_topology_audit.route_value: The classification bypass is potentially cheaper than A2: list KE orbifold limits with A1/Du Val singularities, compute their smooth minimal-resolution topologies, and check whether each topology already has a known Riemannian Einstein metric. If yes, noncollapsed branch-(b) closes within that classified subcase without proving ansatz-independent A2.

route_decision: Do not perform the Page annular E_g-flux experiment as a test of A2: Page is rigid and not an A1/EH degeneration family.

A2/amplitude should be reconnected to the Step-1/Step-7 core-defect scaling. The missing theorem is ansatz-independence/normal-form entry for arbitrary C^0 Ricci-pinched degenerations, not a numerical detection test on exact Einstein examples.

If a flux bridge is pursued, use a bilinear Taub/Wronskian identity at or localized near the balance radius r=t^(2/3); the old linear cosmological E_g flux has the wrong order for the H2-H4 obstruction.
In parallel, pursue the classification bypass for the branch-(b) KE/Hermitian exact-Einstein subcase, but keep its hypotheses explicit and do not infer Kähler from det R_+=0 alone.
